n = int(input())

MOD1 = 998244353
MOD2 = 1000000007

c1 = 0
c2 = 0
totalAnswer = 0
pwr = [1] * 20
sumValues = [0] * 10
buckets = [[] for _ in range(10)]

def executeQuery(p, s):
    global totalAnswer
    for i in range(7):
        val = ((s - p * pwr[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + val * len(buckets[i]) + sumValues[i]) % MOD2
        import bisect
        it = bisect.bisect_left(buckets[i], 998244353 - val)
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer - (len(buckets[i]) - it) * 998244353) % MOD2

def buildNumbers(x, depth):
    global c1, sumValues
    tmp = ((c1 - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1
    c1 += 1
    sumValues[depth] = (sumValues[depth] + tmp) % MOD2
    buckets[depth].append(tmp)
    if depth == 6:
        return
    for digit in range(10):
        buildNumbers(x * 10 + digit, depth + 1)

def traverseTree(x):
    global c2, totalAnswer
    if x > n:
        return
    if (x + 1) * 1000000 <= n + 1 and x * 10000000 > n:
        executeQuery(x, c2)
        c2 += c1
    else:
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + ((c2 - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2
        start_digit = 0 if x != 0 else 1
        for i in range(start_digit, 10):
            traverseTree(x * 10 + i)

# Precompute powers of 10
for i in range(1, 13):
    pwr[i] = pwr[i - 1] * 10

buildNumbers(0, 0)
for i in range(1, 7):
    buckets[i].sort()

traverseTree(0)
print((totalAnswer + MOD2) % MOD2)
